restamp version-sensitive claims (verified live on SDK 0.21.0): `traigent algorithms` lists auto + smart selector names with availability since 0.20.1 (#1751, fixed in 0.20.1); supported smart names bind to the typed backend Optuna strategy and nsga2/cmaes fail fast since 0.20.1 (#1752/#1758); plan/next-steps --backend-url honors the stored auth-login URL before the localhost fallback since 0.20.0 (#1721). Dedupe the doubled offline-mode exports in the Literal First Run block and hoist them above the first python invocation (mirrors references/literal-quickstart.sh); remove the editorial '(read on all current SDK versions)' markers that leaked into references/environment-variables.md code blocks. Fix skills#173: `traigent auth login` stores the key in the encrypted store at ~/.traigent/secure_credentials.enc (TRAIGENT_MASTER_PASSWORD), not ~/.traigent/credentials; legacy plaintext credentials.json is ignored unless TRAIGENT_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_CREDENTIALS=true.

collapse inline SDK-version stamps into the authoritative docs/version-matrix.md rows with `see version-matrix: <fact_id>` pointers; restamp smart-selector executability to the verified 0.20.1 boundary (Traigent/traigent-skills#221; fact E per #190)
add portable audience, topic, lifecycle-stage, and maturity metadata; instructional body unchanged

point every economics decision at the one canonical reference (docs/shared/economics-characterization.v0.md) instead of restating it per skill: drop cost-avoidance as the default posture in favor of the bounded-investment posture (propose a small capped daily budget when conservative value is positive; record value channel, cap, frozen evaluator, required receipt, and stop rule before spending), and add the mandatory explanation duty (show options, recommend one, explain why in the user's own numbers). Mock validation, explicit paid approval, spend caps, receipts, stop rules, and production safety are unchanged. Role here: characterize value and propose a bounded first experiment.
